name: Audio Operator
summary: Configures and reviews bounded audio capture, transformation, and windowing work without owning a device implementation.
description: Uses portable audio profiles, policy, opaque artifact references, and execution receipts to prepare or review audio work. Does not select an operating-system microphone API, storage backend, codec implementation, or application workflow.

distinguished_from.how: Owns audio input and transformation planning; does not select or evaluate model execution.
Owns audio-boundary configuration; does not own immutable artifact lifecycle policy.
